
```{r}
#| include: true
Stage.target <- "Operation"
if (!exists("Stage.label", inherits = FALSE)) {
  Stage.label <- if (length(Standard.target) != 1L) NULL else switch(
    Standard.target,
    ANCOLD = "OBE",
    CDA = "Construction, Operation and Transition",
    GISTM = "Operations and Active-Care Closure",
    Stage.target
  )
}
if (is.null(Stage.label)) Stage.label <- "Operation"
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- paste0(
    if (length(Standard.target) == 1L) paste0(Standard.target, ". ") else "", Stage.label, ". ",
    readCaption("fig.DEQ.operation")
  )
}
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  DEQTable,
  "DEQ.operation figure",
  base = TRUE,
  target = .currentTarget("ID.target"),
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
Sa.log <- TRUE
Tn.log <- TRUE
root <- here::here()
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "DEQ operation figure caption"
)
```
